verdict.rationale: Copilot Chat can explain code concepts in the editor and Enterprise's knowledge bases pull context from docs/repos, which can help orient a developer in a codebase, and agent mode can 'explore' code as part of task execution. However there's no direct evidence of a dedicated codebase-mapping/architecture-overview feature (e.g., repo-wide summarization or dependency visualization) or hands-on accounts confirming it helps developers find where to start making changes. missing for 10: explicit codebase-wide understanding/onboarding feature, independent/hands-on evidence of using Copilot to orient in a large unfamiliar codebase.
